shortDescription: Manages private gateways for VPCs on Apache CloudStack based clouds.

options.name: account
options.description: Account the private gateway is related to.

options.name: api_http_method
options.description: HTTP method used to query the API endpoint. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_METHOD) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_key
options.description: API key of the CloudStack API. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_KEY) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_secret
options.description: Secret key of the CloudStack API. If not set, the C(CLOUDSTACK_SECRET) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: HTTP timeout in seconds. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_TIMEOUT) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_url
options.description: URL of the CloudStack API e.g. https://cloud.example.com/client/api. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_ENDPOINT) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_verify_ssl_cert
options.description: Verify CA authority cert file. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_VERIFY) env variable is considered.

options.name: bypass_vlan_overlap_check
options.description: Whether to bypass VLAN overlap checks during creation.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain the private gateway is related to.

options.name: gateway
options.description: Gateway of the private gateway. Required on I(state=present).

options.name: ip_address
options.description: IP address of the private gateway.

options.name: netmask
options.description: Netmask of the private gateway. Required on I(state=present).

options.name: network
options.description: Name of the isolated network this private gateway is associated with.

options.name: network_acl
options.description: Name of the network ACL to attach to the private gateway.

options.name: network_offering
options.description: Network offering to use for the private gateway network connection.

options.name: physical_network
options.description: Name of the physical network the private gateway belongs to.

options.name: poll_async
options.description: Poll async jobs until job has finished.

options.name: project
options.description: Name of the project the private gateway is related to.

options.name: source_nat_supported
options.description: Whether source NAT should be enabled on the private gateway.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the private gateway.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If V(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_DANGEROUS_NO_TLS_VERIFY) env variable is considered. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: vlan
options.description: VLAN identifier or URI of the private gateway. Required on I(state=present).

options.name: vpc
options.description: Name of the VPC.

options.name: zone
options.description: Name of the zone the VPC belongs to.
